provenance: Self-authored programs executed in isolated original virtual G1; actual CHOOSE keyboard cancellation/selection and returned lists, no physical device or vendor bytes.

choose_cases.name: local_cancel
choose_cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_CHOOSE() BEGIN LOCAL n:=2; LOCAL r:=CHOOSE(n,"Pick",{"a","b","c"}); RETURN {r,n}; END;

choose_cases.name: local_confirm
choose_cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_CHOOSE() BEGIN LOCAL n:=2; LOCAL r:=CHOOSE(n,"Pick",{"a","b","c"}); RETURN {r,n}; END;

choose_cases.name: app_cancel
choose_cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_CHOOSE() BEGIN Spreadsheet.A1:=2; LOCAL r:=CHOOSE(Spreadsheet.A1,"Pick",{"a","b","c"}); RETURN {r,Spreadsheet.A1}; END;

choose_cases.name: app_confirm
choose_cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_CHOOSE() BEGIN Spreadsheet.A1:=2; LOCAL r:=CHOOSE(Spreadsheet.A1,"Pick",{"a","b","c"}); RETURN {r,Spreadsheet.A1}; END;

guide_difference: The2016 guidep606 says cancellation sets the referenced variable0. Original15751 keeps its previous2 and returns0; confirmation returns selectedindex3 and stores3. Native follows the actual controls.
limitations: No global row/column bound or PPL lexer inference from Home-only Z1/Z101 errors. Native currently accepts these documented cell addresses.
Absolute-Z1 attempt09 had no independent history row and is rejected.
Qualified CAS assignment and other attribute slots beyond0/1/3 remain unavailable.

cached_read_control.source: EXPORT ZZT_ANGLE() BEGIN HAngle:=1; STARTAPP("Spreadsheet"); AAngle:=1; A:=90; LOCAL n:=Spreadsheet.A1; STARTAPP("Function"); AAngle:=3; RETURN {HAngle,AAngle,Spreadsheet.A1,n}; END;
cached_read_control.scope: Actual firmware retained the cached cell value during this PPL sequence; Native recalculates each qualified read against the supplied live snapshot. This is a recorded difference, not a claim of matching firmware cache policy.
